message.content: {"issues":[{"number":16,"field":"context","problem":"The quotation changes “우리 ○○병들인데” to “우리 ○○병을린데,” altering the word after ○○병."},{"number":18,"field":"context","problem":"The source says “폭력배 국가를 적극적으로 선전포고하였습니다,” but the transcription says “폭력배 국가를 적극적으로 선포하였습니다,” omitting “전쟁” and changing the expression."},{"number":20,"field":"question","problem":"The source includes “[3점]”, which is omitted."},{"number":20,"field":"context","problem":"The source visibly underlines ㉠ and ㉡; the transcription does not preserve those underlined spans."}],"checked_numbers":[16,17,18,19,20]}
